comment: No source is published. The parameter the maker names Glitch, and the panel prints GLITCH, is read in exactly one place: the branch taken when the clock is absent or has stopped for more than two beats, where it becomes 0.02 times 100 to the power of the knob, that is 20ms to 2 seconds of base delay time. It has no other effect anywhere in the function, so with a clock patched the knob, its attenuverter and its CV jack are all dead. Grain Shift Delay, which is built the same way, takes that base time from a Base time menu item instead, so this looks like a knob that was repurposed and never relabelled. The thirteen grid ratios run 8 down to 1/512. The delay is clamped to between 2 samples and four seconds. Tone runs 0 to 1 on the knob and is mapped to minus 1 to plus 1 before it reaches the damping filter. Feedback runs minus 0.95 to plus 0.95 with a default at the centre, so the module starts with no repeats. Delay units is a menu item with no panel control, and has no widget position, so it gets no tag. Nothing in the plugin reads a channel count, so every port is mono. The panel menu also carries Reload panel and Poll SVG for reload, which every module in this plugin has and which only reload the panel artwork; they are left out.
